title: First Light Fusion
summary: UK fusion company pursuing projectile-driven inertial confinement.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

First Light Fusion uses high-velocity projectiles to implode fuel targets, aiming for a simpler and cheaper route to fusion than lasers. It has demonstrated fusion reactions and is developing a pilot plant design. The approach remains unproven at power-plant scale.

Technology Exposure

  • Projectile fusion
  • Target design
  • Pilot-plant development

What To Watch

  • Net-energy demonstration
  • Funding
  • Engineering scale-up

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
